name: Cowork.
summary: Paid Substack post on setting up Claude Cowork with the /setup-cowork command.
description: A post in Ruben Hassid's How to AI newsletter. It shows the /setup-cowork prompt that has Claude set up Claude Cowork, then walks through the setup and how the author uses Claude. The full post is for paid subscribers; the free preview shows the command and the intro.
